caption: A magnitude-7.1 earthquake struck southwestern Japan’s Kumamoto region, killing at least 34 people and leaving over 80,000 households without water as rescuers race a closing 72-hour window.

Iran fired ballistic missiles at a US military base in Jordan and struck oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Trump to vow Iran would ‘get a beating’ as he hosted Netanyahu at the White House.
Anthropic says its unreleased Claude Mythos model spent 60 hours independently discovering new cryptographic attacks, one making the strongest known attack on AES 200-800 times faster.
Macron convened a crisis cabinet as an unprecedented wildfire burned 42,000 hectares and advanced to within 15km of Bordeaux.
